classification: fully synthetic; no service state, model or Discord used
final_retrieval_timing_concurrency: Run after the concurrent full-suite/benchmark processes finished; no parallel agent or root test/benchmark workload launched for this measurement. Other desktop/system load is uncontrolled.
interpretation: Matching and candidate lookup now use query-prefix/incident/postings indexes. Full shadow decay and byte-identical audit remain global. Final total 3k/1k ratios are 3.456 and 3.564; this evidence does not establish linear end-to-end scaling or universal asymptotic superlinearity before the change.
excluded_development_timing: Earlier after-final run overlapped unit tests and showed higher ratios; all its bytes matched but it is not the final source hash/isolated timing. Development captures retained locally, not substituted into the final measurements.
baseline_artifacts: Large canonical synthetic result/audit/database-digest artifacts are retained only in an isolated local benchmark directory. Public report publishes hashes and full byte-equality results; rerun script to regenerate.
